description: Convert between fitness data formats (FIT, TCX, ZWO, GCN, KRD). FIT output is returned as base64 text unless output_file is given. On the remote endpoint, ZWO input is checked for well-formedness only, not against the XSD, and only structured workouts are accepted.

ftp.description: Athlete FTP in watts. Required for GCN output when the workout has %FTP power targets (resolved to watts)

input_content.description: Inline content (text or base64 for binary)

name: kaiord_convert
